gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-bhutuka-expanded: Expressive stencil letters with wide bridges and tall lowercase lead, while BhuTuka Expanded One settles into a curvy, unhurried text serif. Strong, stout display meets literary calm.
gen-gf-sofia-fs-recia: Sofia looks hand-drawn, its bold strokes all one thickness and every curve generously open. Recia follows with a sharp text serif whose light modulation only shows up when you look closely.
gen-gf-sofia-fs-rowan: Loose, friendly handwriting up top, with crossbars as fat as the stems. And Rowan answers in a serif with gentle contrast, its thin strokes about half the weight of the thick ones.
gen-gf-sofia-plus-jakarta-sans: Relaxed handwriting with no thick or thin strokes, every curve open wide. Then Plus Jakarta Sans arrives, a modern sans-serif that keeps its monoline strokes precise and its curve endings apart.
gen-gf-stalinist-one-fs-paquito: Paquito is confident and approachable, with caps barely rising above the lowercase. Stalinist One handles loud, loosely tracked display work with its brush-like rounded forms, while Paquito stays friendly in running text.
gen-gf-swanky-and-moo-moo-fs-erode: Erode is an editorial serif with a tall middle band and a gentle ebb and flow of stroke weight. But Swanky and Moo Moo brings marker-traced, casual handwriting, best where its relaxed look can lead.
gen-gf-tagesschrift-fs-rowan: Tagesschrift looks like glass tubing bent into flat, bold letters. Rowan, a friendly serif with open curves and mild contrast, carries the reading with ease.
gen-gf-tapestry-fs-bespoke-sans: Tapestry writes like a marker, its horizontals and verticals matching in thickness. Bespoke Sans then keeps text sharp and refined, with generous space where each curve meets the stem.
gen-gf-tapestry-fs-neco: Neco reads with a dignified, measured swell from hairline to stem, and its letters never pinch shut. Tapestry is best as cord-like handwriting where curves stay heavy, while Neco handles the steadier text.
gen-gf-tapestry-fs-plein: Reliable and clean, Plein gives each round letter a clear channel in. But Tapestry brings the personality, its handwriting humming along in a constant line weight.
